items.title: What we know so far after Krakow gun attack
items.summary: Six people were killed in a random shooting in Krakow's main square, and three bodies were later found at the home of the attacker.

items.title: She Kept His Coat for 30 Years, Then Finally Found the Boy Who Gave It to Her After Racial Attack
items.summary: A coat once placed over the shoulders of a young girl whose traditional Korean uniform had been slashed in a racial incident 30 years ago has now been returned to the ‘good Samaritan’ who offered it.…
